resolution_notes: auth.details: AUDITOR RIGHT. Official v2 docs at https://api.hypixel.net/ document Authentication only as Security Scheme Type API Key with Header parameter name API-Key; no key query parameter is specified. rate_limits: AUDITOR MOSTLY RIGHT. Official Limits section states keys are limited per 5-minute intervals and limits depend on application type; RateLimit-* headers assist management (https://api.hypixel.net/). The ~120 req/min figure is not in current official docs. Community wiki cites ~300/5min default (https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/SkyBlock_API) but official docs do not publish that fixed base number, so state application-dependent 5-minute windows + dashboard/headers rather than asserting 300.
